steampad.radial.type.desc: What this slot does: keybind, chat command, screen shortcut, submenu.
steampad.radial.trigger.desc: Run on click (while the wheel is open) or on release (when you let go).
steampad.radial.theme.desc: Pixel-art color preset for the wheel, same presets as the virtual keyboard.
steampad.radial.style.title: Radial Menu — Appearance
steampad.radial.radius.desc: Radius of the wheel — how far the slots sit from the center.
steampad.radial.chip_size.desc: Size of each round slot. Bigger slots also spread the wheel out to keep separation.
steampad.radial.icon_size.desc: Size of the item/effect/character icon inside each slot, independent of slot size.
steampad.radial.background.desc: Dim ring behind the slots so the wheel reads clearly over the world.
steampad.radial.action.desc: The keybind id, command (/...) or screen id this slot triggers.
steampad.radial.label: Label
steampad.radial.label.desc: Text shown for this slot in the wheel.
steampad.radial.icon.desc: Optional icon: an item id like minecraft:diamond, or a single letter.
steampad.settings.steam_input_config.des: Whether SteamPad attaches to Steam (needed for Steam Input slots via action sets and haptics through Steam). The slot layers are edited in Buttons, next to the slots.
steampad.screen.steam_input.title: Steam Input
steampad.cset.deploy_iga_manifest.desc: Writes SteamPad's In-Game-Actions manifest into Steam. WARNING: Steam then treats this game as a native Steam Input title and STOPS emitting the virtual gamepad in Game Mode — normal detection dies unless you bind every action in Steam's configurator. Off (recommended): SteamPad removes its manifests and Steam behaves like before; paddles keep working via F13-F22 slots. Changes need one Steam restart.
steampad.cset.steam_attach_mode.desc: NEVER (default): SDL3/GLFW keep raw control of every controller — Steam Input slots only work via the F13-F22 keyboard trick, no VDF needed. AUTO: also attaches when launched from Steam or under gamescope (Game Mode) — needed for the Steam Input digital-action slot trigger and for haptics through Steam. ALWAYS: attaches whenever Steam is running, any launch method. Attaching can make Steam SEIZE a Steam-managed controller away from SDL3's raw access (confirmed on desktop) — test carefully after changing this.
steampad.slot.layer.menu.desc: What the 10 slots trigger while a non-inventory screen is open (settings, pause, etc.). The Gameplay layer lives in Botones, unchanged.
steampad.slot.layer.inventory.desc: What the 10 slots trigger while any container/inventory screen is open.
steampad.slot.layer.mounted.desc: What the 10 slots trigger while riding an entity (horse, boat, minecart...).
steampad.slot.layer.hint: Empty = does nothing in this layer. The same slot can do something different per layer.
steampad.keyboard.settings.title: Virtual Keyboard
steampad.keyboard.enabled.desc: On-screen keyboard driven by the controller for text fields.
steampad.keyboard.autoshow.desc: Show the keyboard automatically when a text field is focused.
steampad.keyboard.sounds.desc: Play a click when typing on the virtual keyboard.
steampad.keyboard.stick_speed.desc: How fast the stick moves the free-floating cursor over the keys. Lower = slower and more precise, higher = faster.
steampad.keyboard.stick_mode.desc: Velocity: the stick moves the cursor over the keys. Pointer: the stick deflection points directly at a keyboard region (Steam Big Picture style) — flick toward the letter, release, press A.
steampad.keyboard.theme.desc: Pixel-art color preset for the keyboard, inspired by Minecraft materials.
steampad.keyboard.dual_stick.desc: Both sticks each move their own pointer over the keys, like Steam's keyboard: LB presses the left pointer's key, RB the right pointer's. A still presses the main selection; the caret moves with L3/R3. Off: classic single-stick keyboard with LB/RB moving the caret.
steampad.settings.third_person_enabled.d: Over-the-shoulder camera offset, credited design from Leawind's Third-Person mod (MIT). Shifts the third-person camera to the side instead of straight behind you, without ever clipping into walls.
steampad.settings.third_person_side.desc: Which side the camera sits on in third person. Cycle it in-game with the bound button (Buttons → Gameplay).
steampad.settings.third_person_offset.de: How far to the side the camera sits, as a percentage of one block. Automatically pulled in if it would clip through a wall.
steampad.settings.third_person_aiming.de: While charging a bow, crossbow, or trident, ease the camera to a closer offset — credited design from Leawind's Third-Person mod.
steampad.settings.third_person_aiming_of: The closer offset used while aiming, as a percentage of one block.
steampad.settings.third_person_assign_bi: Opens Buttons -> Gameplay, where the physical button for cycling Left/Center/Right on the fly is assigned (unbound by default).
steampad.settings.third_person_free_look: Full free-look, credited design from Leawind's Third-Person mod (MIT): the camera rotates independently of your character's facing, with a functional crosshair and live offset/distance adjustment. Supersedes the simple offset above while on. Assign THIRD_PERSON_FREE_LOOK_TOGGLE and THIRD_PERSON_ADJUST in Buttons -> Gameplay to use it in-game.
steampad.settings.third_person_rotate_mo: How your character's body faces while you're standing still and looking around freely. Aiming or attacking/using always overrides this to face your actual target, in every mode.
steampad.settings.third_person_pitch_loc: Keeps the free camera level — up/down stick input no longer tilts it.
steampad.settings.third_person_free_dist: How far behind you the free camera sits. Adjustable live in-game by holding THIRD_PERSON_ADJUST and pressing D-pad up/down.
steampad.settings.third_person_crosshair: Shows the crosshair in third person and makes attack/use/mine actually target whatever it's over — "shoot like first-person", from the reference mod's own description.
steampad.settings.third_person_predictiv: While charging a bow/crossbow/trident, faces you at the nearest likely target under the crosshair so the shot actually lands there, instead of just wherever the camera looks.
steampad.settings.third_person_camera_re: Pushing the stick forward moves away from the camera (not from wherever your body already faces), and your character turns to match — the action-game feel. Off by default: touches the movement code directly, so try it and confirm it feels right before relying on it.
steampad.screen.onboarding.title: Welcome to SteamPad
steampad.onboarding.section.highlights: A quick look at what's here
steampad.onboarding.radial.desc: A Bedrock-style pie menu for hotbar/action shortcuts — hold the bound button to open it. Opens the editor so you can see it built.
steampad.onboarding.emotes.desc: A dedicated dance/emote wheel, separate from the radial menu, with its own library and preview.
steampad.onboarding.zoom.desc: Spyglass-style FOV zoom with an adjustable level, an optional marker beacon, and cinematic letterbox bars.
steampad.onboarding.third_person.desc: An over-the-shoulder offset, or the full free camera — independent rotation, a functional crosshair, live adjustment.
steampad.onboarding.haptics.desc: Try every haptic effect on demand — combat hits, environmental cues, danger pulses — without reproducing them in-game first.
steampad.onboarding.buttons.desc: See and rebind every action — including a few that ship unassigned on purpose.
steampad.settings.manage_profiles.desc: Save and switch between named bundles of your whole control setup (bindings, sensitivity, aim assist, radial layout) — e.g. "Exploration" vs. "Combat".
steampad.screen.profiles.title: Config Profiles
steampad.settings.use_sdl3.desc: When Steam Input is unavailable, use SDL3 (if installed) to read controllers. Brings a broad device database and rumble. Falls back to GLFW if SDL3 is missing.
steampad.settings.use_glfw.desc: The always-available detection baseline. Reads controllers through GLFW (bundled with the game). Leave on unless you specifically want to disable controller support without Steam.
steampad.settings.load_natives.desc: Load the bundled Steamworks native libraries at startup. Required for Steam Input. Turn off only if natives fail to extract in a sandboxed launcher.
steampad.settings.custom_natives_path.de: Directory to extract Steam native libraries to. Use a writable path if the default temp dir fails (common under Flatpak).
steampad.settings.block_reach_around.des: Allow placing blocks against the back face you are looking at (quality-of-life). Choose where it applies: off, singleplayer, LAN, or everywhere.
steampad.settings.allow_server_vibration: Let servers trigger controller rumble via plugin messages. Off by default for privacy/comfort.
steampad.settings.keyboard_movement.desc: Treat the left stick as 8-direction digital movement (like WASD) instead of analog. Useful for some anti-cheat or precise builds.
steampad.settings.add_server_whitelist.d: Add the server you are currently connected to, to the keyboard-movement whitelist.
steampad.settings.ui_sounds.desc: Play click/navigation sounds when moving through SteamPad menus.
steampad.settings.notify_low_battery.des: Show an on-screen warning when the active controller's battery gets low.
steampad.settings.out_of_focus_input.des: Keep reading the controller even when the Minecraft window is not focused.
steampad.settings.button_guide_scale.des: Size of the on-screen button hint overlay.
Brief, soft controller pulse each time the radial menu selection changes.
steampad.settings.radial_select_haptics_: How strong that pulse feels. Has no effect while the toggle above is off.
steampad.settings.window_arrange_enabled: Turns on the Select+RB window-layout shortcut. This is NOT in-game splitscreen — it resizes and moves the game's OS window, the same way you'd arrange windows for local multiplayer across multiple Minecraft instances. Hold Select (View/Back) and press RB to cycle: Windowed -> Left -> Right -> Top -> Bottom -> the 4 corners -> Fullscreen -> back to Windowed.
steampad.settings.window_arrange_gap.des: Pixel gap left between tiled windows so their borders don't visually touch.
steampad.settings.enhanced_deck_driver.d: Experimental tweaks for Steam Deck input handling. May change behavior in Game Mode. Leave off unless testing.
steampad.settings.copy_debug.desc: Copy a full diagnostic report (backend, controllers, environment) to the clipboard for troubleshooting.
steampad.screen.basic.title: Controller — Basic
steampad.screen.advanced.title: Controller — Advanced
steampad.cset.vmouse_sensitivity.desc: Cursor speed when navigating menus with the left stick.
steampad.cset.vmouse_snap.desc: The virtual cursor gently settles onto the nearest slot/button when you release the stick. Turn off for a fully free cursor — D-pad cell-to-cell navigation keeps working either way.
steampad.cset.invert_look_y.desc: Flip the vertical camera direction (push up to look down).
steampad.cset.reduce_aim.desc: Lower look sensitivity while using items like the bow or spyglass.
steampad.cset.look_curve.desc: How the stick maps to camera speed. Higher = wider precision band in the middle of the stick's travel with speed reserved for full tilt (console-shooter feel, ~2.2). 1.0 = linear.
steampad.cset.turn_boost.desc: Holding the stick pegged at the edge briefly ramps the turn speed up to a turbo — fast 180° turns without losing mid-stick precision, like console shooters.
steampad.cset.attack_repeat.desc: While the attack trigger stays held, swing again automatically each time the weapon cooldown refills — console-style combat. Mining blocks is unaffected.
steampad.cset.aim_assist.desc: While charging a bow, crossbow or trident: the camera slows down over targets and drifts gently toward them, console-native style. Never fires or aims for you. Also engages for any modded weapon whose item extends vanilla's RangedWeaponItem — the standard base class modded bows/crossbows use (e.g. mods built with the Ranged Weapon API). Full custom weapon/firing systems that don't use vanilla's charge-and-release mechanic at all (e.g. gun mods like TaCZ) aren't detectable this way and need dedicated support.
steampad.cset.aim_assist_strength.desc: Scales both the slowdown over targets and the gentle pull toward them.
steampad.cset.sneak_mode.desc: HOLD: sneak while the button is held. TOGGLE: press to toggle sneak on/off.
steampad.cset.sprint_mode.desc: HOLD: sprint while the stick is clicked. TOGGLE: press to toggle sprint.
steampad.cset.auto_jump.desc: Automatically jump up single-block ledges while moving.
steampad.cset.no_fly_drifting.desc: Stop creative-flight momentum immediately when the stick is released.
steampad.cset.calibration.desc: Open the live deadzone calibration screen.
steampad.cset.bindings.desc: View and edit button bindings by category.
steampad.cset.allow_vibration.desc: Enable controller rumble for this controller.
steampad.cset.hd_haptics.desc: Use high-definition haptics where supported (DualSense, Steam Deck).
steampad.cset.test_vibration.desc: Fire a short rumble pulse to test the current settings.
steampad.cset.haptics_test.desc: Preview every named vibration effect on demand, without needing to trigger it for real in-game.
steampad.haptics.test.title: Haptics Test Palette
steampad.haptics.test.heartbeat.desc: The thump that echoes vanilla's low-HP heartbeat sound (DANGER tier).
steampad.haptics.test.death.desc: The pulse fired the instant the death screen appears (CRITICAL tier).
steampad.haptics.test.fall_light.desc: A short fall's landing thump (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.fall_heavy.desc: A long fall's landing thump (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.hunger.desc: Fires while food is at or below the sprint-disable threshold (AMBIENT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.drowning.desc: Panic pulse as air runs out (DANGER tier).
steampad.haptics.test.eating.desc: Soft munch pulse matching the chew cadence (COSMETIC tier).
steampad.haptics.test.slime_walk.desc: The continuous underfoot hum (AMBIENT tier) — the one currently under investigation, see STATE.md.
steampad.haptics.test.honey_walk.desc: The gentler occasional underfoot tick (COSMETIC tier).
steampad.haptics.test.water_splash.desc: Fires once on entering water (COSMETIC tier).
steampad.haptics.test.glide.desc: The soft continuous presence while flying (AMBIENT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.lightning.desc: Sharp crackly pulse for a close strike (AMBIENT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.warden.desc: The low, heavy, oppressive proximity pulse (DANGER tier).
A sharp pulse on a nearby teleport (DANGER tier).
steampad.haptics.test.boss_ping.desc: The mystery proximity ping before you've engaged a boss (DANGER tier).
steampad.haptics.test.portal.desc: Heavy grave pulse near a portal (DANGER tier).
steampad.haptics.test.weapon_sword.desc: Sharp, crisp — the sword's own signature (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.weapon_axe.desc: Heavier, more blunt than a sword (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.weapon_trident.des: A heavy polearm feel, between axe and mace (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.weapon_mace.desc: The mace's own heavy, low-frequency thud (IMPACT tier).
Falling mace hit — the single biggest thud in the game (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.weapon_arrow.desc: A short, sharp "point" tap — deliberately different from a melee hit (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.weapon_kill.desc: The payoff bump any weapon gets when the hit is lethal (CRITICAL tier).
steampad.haptics.test.block_broken.desc: Fires when mining an ore/precious block (IMPACT tier).
steampad.haptics.test.radial_select.desc: The brief pulse on a radial-wheel slot change (COSMETIC tier) — uses the base value, not the strength slider.
steampad.cset.gyro_behaviour.desc: RELATIVE adds gyro on top of stick aiming; ABSOLUTE maps orientation directly.
steampad.cset.yaw_mode.desc: Which gyro rotation axis controls turning (yaw, roll, or both).
steampad.cset.require_button.desc: How gyro aiming engages: hold, toggle, invert, or always on (off).
steampad.cset.flick_stick.desc: Flick-stick aiming: a quick flick of the right stick instantly turns you.
steampad.cset.mixed_input.desc: Allow keyboard/mouse and controller input at the same time.
steampad.cset.zoom_hold.desc: On: zoom only while the button is held. Off: press once to zoom, press again to release.
steampad.cset.zoom_fov.desc: Field of view while zoomed, in degrees. Lower = more magnification. Adjustable in-game with the D-pad while zooming.
steampad.cset.zoom_step.desc: Degrees added or removed per D-pad step while zooming.
steampad.cset.zoom_smooth.desc: Ease the zoom in and out instead of snapping instantly.
steampad.cset.zoom_smoothing.desc: How fast the smooth zoom glides. Higher = snappier, lower = softer.
steampad.cset.zoom_auto_sens.desc: Slow the camera to match the zoom level automatically, so aiming feels consistent with what you see.
steampad.cset.zoom_sens.desc: Fixed camera speed multiplier while zoomed (used when auto sensitivity is off).
steampad.cset.zoom_dpad.desc: While zooming, D-pad up/down changes the zoom level (their normal actions are suspended during the zoom).
steampad.cset.zoom_marker.desc: While zoomed, pressing A drops a temporary particle beacon on the spot you're aiming at — 'let's go there'. A's normal action is suspended during the zoom.
steampad.cset.zoom_marker_style.desc: Shape of the beacon's particles. Try each one and keep whichever reads best to you.
steampad.cset.zoom_marker_secs.desc: How long the beacon stays visible.
steampad.cset.zoom_marker_chat.desc: Also send the marked coordinates as a chat message so other players can see where you mean.
steampad.cset.zoom_reset.desc: On: D-pad adjustments last only for that zoom — releasing returns to your configured level. Off: the last adjusted level is kept.
steampad.cset.zoom_bobbing.desc: Suppress view bobbing during the zoom to avoid visual wobble. Your setting is restored when the zoom ends.
steampad.cset.zoom_render_distance_boost: Temporarily raises both your Render Distance AND Simulation Distance by this many chunks only while actively zoomed, restored the instant the zoom ends (in singleplayer, chunks beyond Simulation Distance aren't loaded server-side at all, so both have to move together). This genuinely costs performance while active — more chunks are generated, lit and meshed on the spot — there is no way around that cost, it's inherent to how Minecraft loads terrain, not something SteamPad can optimize away. Keep this modest (2-4) on Steam Deck-class hardware; higher values can cause a noticeable stutter when the zoom starts/ends. 0 = off (default).
steampad.cset.zoom_cinematic_bars.desc: Black letterbox bars close in from the top and bottom while zooming, like a movie aspect ratio, and open back up on release. Purely visual (2D overlay), off by default.
steampad.cset.zoom_cinematic_bars_height: How tall each bar gets at full zoom, as a percent of screen height.
steampad.cset.ingame_guide_detail.desc: How many of your bound actions show an on-screen hint: Minimal is the 5 core actions, Normal is a curated console-style set of 10, Full shows every bound action.
steampad.calibration.hint: Move the sticks to verify the deadzone. Adjust it in Basic settings.
steampad.vmouse.label: Mouse
steampad.notification.no_steam: Steam not detected. Launch Minecraft from Steam.
steampad.act.steam_slot.desc: Fires when Steam sends this slot's action OR its F-key. Recommended setup: in Steam's controller layout, map a back paddle to the F-key shown (F13-F22) — Steam emits it as a keyboard press and this slot triggers the keybind you pick here. Works in Game Mode with no extra setup in the mod. Held paddles stay held (zoom-style keybinds work).
steampad.bind.panel.slot_inactive: Steam Input actions are not active — but the F-key route always works: map your paddle to this slot's F-key (F13-F22) in Steam's controller layout.
steampad.bind.panel.slot_desktop: Desktop session: the mod stays detached from Steam so your pads keep raw input — you can bind paddles directly (P1-P4) like any button. Slots still respond to their F-key (F13-F22) if you map it in Steam's layout.
steampad.act.inv_select.desc: Pick up or place the item under the cursor.
steampad.act.gui_back.desc: Go back or close the screen.
steampad.act.emote_wheel_config.desc: The dedicated emote wheel: pick which emote sits in each slot from the emote library. It's its own independent wheel with its own binding — it no longer shares pages with your regular radial menu.
steampad.bind.emote_wheel.desc: Hold to open the emote wheel directly, move the right stick to choose, release to play the emote. Unbound by default — assign it here. Moving cancels a playing emote.
steampad.emote.library.title: Emote Library
steampad.emote.library.empty: No emotes found — drop .json emote files into the folders below.
steampad.emote.library.folders: Folders: .minecraft/emotes (shared with other emote mods) and config/steampad/emotes
steampad.emote.preview.empty: Hover or select an emote to preview it here.
steampad.emote.preview.no_world: (open a world to see the animated preview)
steampad.emote.wheel.title: Emote Wheel
steampad.emote.wheel.full: All emote wheels are in use.
steampad.bind.pick_block.desc: Pick the block you are looking at.
steampad.bind.zoom.desc: Hold (or toggle) to zoom the view, spyglass-style. Adjust the level with the D-pad while zooming. Configure behavior in Advanced → Zoom.
steampad.bind.third_person_side_cycle.de: Cycles the over-the-shoulder camera side left → center → right. Only does anything while Better Third Person is enabled in Global Settings.
steampad.bind.third_person_free_look_tog: Turns the free camera on/off without opening a menu. Only does anything while Free Camera is enabled in Global Settings.
steampad.bind.third_person_adjust.desc: While held, the right stick moves the camera offset and D-pad up/down changes the distance instead of their normal actions. Only does anything while Free Camera is enabled in Global Settings.
steampad.bind.open_keyboard.desc: Force-open the virtual keyboard in any inventory-like screen — for mods whose own search box can't be auto-detected (e.g. Roughly Enough Items).
steampad.bind.panel.none: Select an action to see details.
steampad.bind.panel.fixed: Fixed action — bound to a stick/button by design.
steampad.bindings.listening_chord_first: Chord for %s — press the FIRST button (modifier)
steampad.bindings.listening_chord_second: Chord for %s — modifier %s, now press the SECOND button
steampad.radial.wheel.desc: Wheel being edited. Add as many as you need — LB/RB cycles them in-game (carousel).
steampad.radial.wheel.delete.title: Delete Wheel
steampad.radial.wheel.delete.confirm: Delete Wheel %s? It has %s shortcuts configured.
steampad.radial.type.keybind.desc: Triggers a Minecraft or mod keybind when this slot is chosen.
steampad.radial.type.chat_command.desc: Sends a chat command or message (use /command).
steampad.radial.type.submenu.desc: Opens another radial wheel for more options.
steampad.radial.type.screen_shortcut.des: Opens a screen (inventory, pause, controller select).
steampad.radial.type.malilib_keybind.des: Triggers a MaLiLib keybind (if MaLiLib is installed).
steampad.radial.edit_hint: Select a slot and press LT to edit
